content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks nigeria

Stripe provides payment processing in only 46 countries, leaving out vast regions, including Nigeria. PayPal, while more widespread, often suspends accounts with little recourse, leaving funds inaccessible for up to 180 days. On the other hand, a sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH offers a permanent solution, allowing creators to own their entire payment and delivery system without relying on third-party platforms that can restrict or suspend access.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude many regions, creating barriers for digital creators in countries like Nigeria and Ghana. This exclusion forces creators to look for alternatives, often leading to frustration and loss of potential revenue. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure not only bypasses these restrictions but also provides a reliable framework for creators to operate independently, ensuring their businesses are not beholden to the whims of big payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed is crucial for digital creators. Stripe and PayPal often impose delays, with PayPal's account freezes leading to potential cash flow issues. Additionally, their fees can accumulate quickly, eating into profits. Sovereign commerce solutions like NOWPayments offer automatic on-chain verification with a mere 0.5% fee, ensuring that creators receive payments swiftly and without hidden charges, allowing for better financial planning and sustainability.
Sovereign commerce means true ownership of your digital storefront.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The ownership of digital assets is a core concern for creators. Stripe and PayPal can dictate terms and conditions, potentially jeopardizing a creator's control over their business. With COREMERCH, creators maintain full ownership of their digital storefronts and customer data, eliminating third-party interference. Automated solutions ensure seamless delivery and payment processing while providing a framework that can scale as the creator's needs grow.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When considering the best architecture for selling digital products, creators in restricted countries should prioritize solutions that offer sovereignty and control. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a robust platform with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, enabling creators to build a secure and efficient online store in just 48 hours. This infrastructure not only enhances operational efficiency but also protects against the unpredictability of traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid account freezes and holds with traditional payment processors.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
